messages:
jordan: Quick question — before we flip the safepath operator delegation to ops, can we agree on the checkpoint + telemetry gating we want? I want an ops-friendly handoff that still gives platform a fast way to pause/rollback.

samina: +1 on needing a clear pause signal. thinking: two checkpoints — pre-apply dryrun (sampling 1%) and post-apply telemetry check (10m window) with regression alerts.

ev an: small nit: 1% dryrun might not exercise hot codepaths. can we target 2–3% with traffic bucketing to cover long-tail routes?

jordan: good call. 3% for dryrun then ramp to 10% for a smoke window before full roll. also want a safety TTL: auto-pause if error-rate delta > 1.5x baseline or p95 latency regressed > 30%.

maria: what telemetry sources? console dashboard + tracing? ops wants a single indicator to click pause.

samina: dashboard should show: error-rate delta, p95 latency delta, per-route hit-rate, and config-apply exceptions. tracing link for 5 lowest-latency-flavor samples.

ev an: we should also emit an audit event for every config apply with commit id, operator, and dryrun-result hash so we can replay or reconcile.

jordan: agreed. audit event + console action button. UX: console button warns and requires ack + reason and offers quick rollback.

maria: ops asked for an emergency revert that doesn't require a deploy. can we expose a rollback toggle that re-applies previous snapshot within 30s?

samina: technically yes if we keep the last N snapshots warm and ensure idempotent apply. need to add a pre-apply lock to avoid concurrent writes.

ev an: pre-apply lock + optimistic etag check. also add a live-preview API that returns the effective config for a given cohort hash so ops can validate before applying.

jordan: draft flow I sketched: 1) create change (dryrun:true) -> run dryrun across 3% cohort -> collect telemetry -> if pass, open smoke window (10%) -> wait 10m -> if pass, promote to 100%. auto-pause triggers on thresholds. ops manual override allowed but logged.

\maria: can we add a soft-ttl on manual overrides so they expire after 24h unless re-acknowledged? ops likes the idea to avoid stale emergency toggles.
\samina: sounds good. also want a 'canary shadow' mode where traffic is routed to new config but results are shadowed for a sample of requests so we can compare outputs without affecting quotas. useful for routing policy changes.
\ev an: +1 for shadow compare. make sure we persist compare metrics per-route and surface them in console with small-sample warning.
\jordan: question about API: should we extend the runtime config API with fields: {dryrun_pct, smoke_pct, smoke_window_mins, auto_pause_thresholds, manual_override_ttl, shadow_mode}. Anyone object to that shape?
\samina: looks fine. add 'auditor_tags' list for linking to eval suites.
\maria: ops: please confirm you can build a single-click pause that calls the API with manual_override=true and reason.
\ops-bot: Deploy-bot: last snapshot warm: snapshot-2026-03-15T12:01Z. Note: no active locks. :white_check_mark:
\ev an: one more: we need observability contracts for backend teams — e.g., emit metric `config.apply.success`, `config.apply.errors`, `config.dryrun.variance` and traces with tag config.change_id.
\jordan: ok I'll draft an RFC with the flow, API shape, sample console mockups, and the metric/tracing contract. target review EOD tomorrow. @samina @evan @maria please skim and flag blockers. :thumbsup:
